# Social Studio

> Open-source Flutter/Dart project for programmatic social video rendering. The desktop CLI turns local JSON Story jobs, photos, audio and supplied captions into MP4, a cover and an offline review page. Mobile and additional render targets remain roadmap work.

## Start here

- [Project overview and quick start](README.md): Current capabilities, installation, goals and limits.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): Task navigation, canonical sources and code search terms.
- [Contributor and agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Repository rules; read before changing code.
- [Contribution standards](CONTRIBUTING.md): Design, testing and independent review requirements.

## Use and integrate

- [Desktop CLI guide](flutter/social_studio/README.md): Local Story input, rendering, sequences, outputs and boundaries.
- [Specification guide](spec/README.md): General v0 catalog and the separate desktop authoring contract.
- [Reuse map](docs/reuse.md): Existing solutions and real consumers.
- [Architecture decisions](docs/decisions/): Technical decisions with status, context and evidence.
